definitions.explanation: The light emitted by the sun; often used in literary or poetic contexts.

examples.japanese: {陽光|ようこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧{陽光|ようこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧。
{陽光|ようこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The garden bathed in sunlight is beautiful.

notes:
{陽光|ようこう} is a literary or poetic word for sunlight, evoking warmth and brightness. It appears more often in writing (novels, essays, travel descriptions) than in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陽光|ようこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧: sunlight streams in
- {陽光|ようこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to bathe in sunlight
- {陽光|ようこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされる→照らす：04669_terasu⟧: to be illuminated by sunlight
- ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧{陽光|ようこう}: warm sunshine
- {陽光|ようこう}⟦{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ→降り注ぐ：07976_furisosogu⟧: sunlight pouring down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧: sunlight (neutral tone; also the place name Nikko)
- ⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧: sunshine (common everyday word)
- ⟦{太陽光|たいようこう}→太陽光：06209_taiyoukou⟧: solar light (technical, as in ⟦{太陽光|たいようこう}→太陽光：06209_taiyoukou⟧⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧, solar panel)
- {陽|ひ}: sun, sunlight (literary/classical)
